title: Cleft Sentences
completion_message: ¡Magnífico! Has dominado las oraciones hendidas ('Cleft sentences'). Ahora puedes dirigir la atención de tu oyente exactamente hacia donde quieres, con el máximo énfasis posible. Eres un maestro de la sintaxis.

parts.visual:
Las oraciones hendidas (Cleft sentences) se usan en inglés para dar énfasis a una parte específica de la oración. Cortan (cleave) una oración normal en dos partes. 

1. It-Clefts (El énfasis va después del verbo 'to be'): 
- Normal: John broke the window yesterday. 
- Énfasis en John: IT WAS John WHO broke the window yesterday. 
- Énfasis en la ventana: IT WAS the window THAT John broke. 
- Énfasis en cuándo: IT WAS yesterday THAT John broke the window. 

Estructura: It + is/was + [Lo que enfatizas] + who/that...
parts.audio: Welcome to Cleft Sentences for Emphasis. In English, we use cleft sentences to put focus on a specific part of a sentence. We cleave, or split, the sentence into two. Number 1: It-Clefts. The emphasis comes immediately after the verb 'to be'. Let's take a normal sentence: John broke the window yesterday. To emphasize John: IT WAS John WHO broke the window yesterday. To emphasize the window: IT WAS the window THAT John broke. To emphasize when it happened: IT WAS yesterday THAT John broke the window. The structure is: It plus is or was, plus the thing you want to emphasize, plus who or that.

parts.visual:
2. Wh-Clefts (Lo que quiero/necesito/hice...): 
- Normal: I need a coffee right now. 
- Énfasis: WHAT I need IS a coffee right now. 
- Normal: She wants peace and quiet. 
- Énfasis: WHAT she wants IS peace and quiet. 

3. All-Clefts (Todo lo que / Lo único que...): 
- Normal: I just want to sleep. 
- Énfasis: ALL I want IS to sleep. 
- Normal: He only touched the button. 
- Énfasis: ALL he did WAS touch the button. 

4. The reason why / The place where / The person who: 
- Normal: I love Paris because of the food. 
- Énfasis: THE REASON WHY I love Paris IS the food.
parts.audio: Number 2: Wh-Clefts. These usually start with 'What' to mean 'the thing that'. Normal: I need a coffee right now. Emphasis: WHAT I need IS a coffee right now. Normal: She wants peace and quiet. Emphasis: WHAT she wants IS peace and quiet. Number 3: All-Clefts. 'All' here means 'the only thing'. Normal: I just want to sleep. Emphasis: ALL I want IS to sleep. Normal: He only touched the button. Emphasis: ALL he did WAS touch the button. Number 4: Using phrases like The reason why, The place where, or The person who. Normal: I love Paris because of the food. Emphasis: THE REASON WHY I love Paris IS the food.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la opción correcta para formar una oración hendida de alto impacto.

questions.question: Normal: Sarah solved the problem. -> Énfasis en Sarah: ____ Sarah who solved the problem.
Normal: I hate the humidity in this city. -> Énfasis en la humedad: ____ I hate is the humidity in this city.
Normal: I just need five minutes of your time. -> Énfasis: ____ I need is five minutes of your time.
Normal: We met in London in 2015. -> Énfasis en el lugar: ____ we met was London.
questions.explanation: The place where we met was London.

questions.question: Normal: He quit his job because he was stressed. -> Énfasis en la razón: ____ he quit his job was the stress.
questions.explanation: The reason why he quit his job was...

questions.question: Normal: I only want a glass of water. -> Énfasis: ____ I want is a glass of water.
questions.explanation: All I want is a glass of water.

questions.question: Normal: The CEO made the final decision. -> Énfasis en el CEO: It was the CEO ____ made the final decision.
questions.explanation: It was the CEO who made...

questions.question: Normal: I really appreciate your honesty. -> Énfasis: What I really appreciate ____ your honesty.
questions.explanation: What I appreciate IS your honesty.

questions.question: Normal: They bought the house in 1999. -> Énfasis en el año: It was in 1999 ____ they bought the house.
questions.explanation: It was in 1999 THAT they bought... (En clefts temporales con 'It was', solemos usar 'that').

questions.question: Normal: I don't understand the last paragraph. -> Énfasis: What I don't understand ____ the last paragraph.
Normal: Mark gave me this book. -> Énfasis en el libro: ____ Mark gave me.
Normal: The constant noise annoys me. -> Énfasis: ____ the constant noise.
questions.explanation: What annoys me is the constant noise.

questions.question: Normal: She only sent an email. (No hizo nada más). -> Énfasis con All: ____ send an email.
questions.explanation: All she did was send an email.

questions.question: Normal: The lack of communication caused the failure. -> Énfasis: The ____ the lack of communication.
questions.explanation: The reason for the failure was...

questions.question: Normal: They are trying to hide the truth. -> Énfasis: ____ to hide the truth.
options: What they are trying to do is
questions.correct_answer: What they are trying to do is
questions.explanation: What they are trying to do is hide the truth.

questions.question: Normal: I need you to listen to me. -> Énfasis: ____ you to listen to me.
options: Both 'All I need is for' and 'What I need is for' are correct
questions.correct_answer: Both 'All I need is for' and 'What I need is for' are correct
questions.explanation: All I need is for you... / What I need is for you...

questions.question: Normal: We must focus on the budget. -> Énfasis: The thing we must focus on ____ the budget.
questions.explanation: The thing we must focus on IS the budget.

questions.question: Normal: You need a good rest. -> Énfasis: ____ a good rest.
questions.explanation: What you need is a good rest.

questions.question: Normal: I spoke to the manager, not the secretary. -> Énfasis: ____ the manager that I spoke to.
questions.explanation: It was the manager that I spoke to.

questions.question: Normal: He always complains about the weather. -> Énfasis: The only thing ____ about the weather.
questions.explanation: The only thing he complains about is the weather.

questions.question: ____ was John who broke it.
____ I need is a coffee.
____ I want is to sleep.
The reason ____ I left was the money.
The ____ where we met was Paris.
It was the CEO ____ signed it.
What I hate ____ the noise.
All he ____ was touch the button. (Pasado de do)
It was in 1999 ____ they bought it.
The person ____ helped me was Sarah.
